reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.5 Acting/Cast 4.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers The plot was disjointed I watched this on Song Yujia marathon drama last year and found out she collaborated with Wang Dao Tie..It's really hard to give a review. I can't say it's good, and I can't say it's bad. The premises was quite good but this drama feel disjointed about ML backstory and FL backstory seems not to be match. Surprisingly, I found Wang Daotie to be much better in the drama. He looks younger in here. From the ML perspective, FL is too saintly. She always tries to run away, betrays ML's love, and even causes the death of ML's sister. In fact, because of FL's series of actions, you can empathize with the ML and feel sorry for him. But ML is real villain. He's not an undercover agent; he's the head of a criminal organization leader. So, it's not wrong for FL to try everything to escape. ML runs human trafficking organization and FL happened to check on the case. It was quite unfortunate case in this drama. They used to much darker filter in this drama and it's not looking good. title: Xue Ran Jiang Yue
also_known_as: Blood Ignites the River and the Moon
synopsis: Lin Shu Yue, the eldest daughter of the Lin family, was believed by the outside world to have suffered intellectual impairment after a fire, becoming someone easily manipulated by others. In reality, she possesses the Hidden Mountain Clan’s unique healing bloodline, and her mother and fellow clanspeople all perished in that very fire. For ten years, she has pretended to have amnesia while secretly investigating the dark secrets behind Lin Family Pharmaceuticals, meticulously planning her revenge. Jiang Jin, the power holder of the Jiang family, appears cold and ruthless on the surface, but has long been investigating the problems surrounding Lin Family Pharmaceuticals. Driven by their own motives, the two cross paths. Through mutual probing and cooperation, amid truth, schemes, and strategic mind games, a relationship gradually develops between them—one that transcends mere mutual benefit. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Gothic fantasy about blood, magic elixir and true love I discovered this drama when I was doing a reddit assignment on Xie Yu Wang. Darn, both Xie Yu Wang and Han Jia Hui are my favourites so I was excited about this drama. I watched it last night and wow, I was surprised.What I liked:1. Fantasy - I never thought this could be a fantasy drama - I liked the fantasy element a lot. Magic blood and its healing properties. Experimentation for an elixir.2. Romance - Yes, finally a ML having a spring dream. That dream was spicy and it made sense why he had that dream. They had a rocky relationship with their circumstance going against them but I enjoyed their love story. 3. ML characterisation - I liked that ML got curious about FL and figured out her secret in the first act. Then he offered a partnership deal to FL. He too had a mission to accomplish.4. FL characterisation - She's a complex character. She had to put on a mask to save herself from being exploited. In third act, she was conflicted between revenge and love. Good character growth.5. Acting - It's good to see Han Jia Hui in a dramatic role - she challenged herself. Xie Yu Wang played his role well too. I liked the chemistry between them - there was a tacit understanding and strong sexual tension between them.6. Styling - Great outfits worn by ML. I liked most outfits worn by FL except the first dress. The red stains looked like blood and the colour tone - hhhhmm it wasn't a pretty dress to me.What I disliked:1. Abuse - I pitied FL for the abuse she had to endure. I hated that the kids were part of the experiment.2. Antagonists - FL's father was evil. reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers Plot is okay but this is for fans I watch this because of Tiktok ads and I quite have 50:50 feeling about this. The plot is actually Ok since i like revenge drama but i was on mood to torturing myself so i give myself try.The pacing was fast, the storylines were well-developed until 15 minutes of ending and some of the plot twists and climaxes The ML and FL were intelligent and articulate, and most importantly, they were a great match.Personally, i don't fond of Zuo Yi acting because she always look one dimensional character and her mimic is always same when she frown and her acting is not improving compare to her same peer on pioneer era of short drama. Zhang Tingrui has improved a lot compared to his previous drama with Han Yutong. He might be a bit too immature for a domineering CEO role, but he's very suitable for this kind of younger, competitive, and scheming character. The chemistry between the leads still sufficient to keep me watching this.The show was average, but I didn't like the ending; it had to be a complete mess and fall into generic formula. reviews.author: TTR - The Truth Review
reviews.review_text: Overall 2.0 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 2.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers If you enjoy watching heroes suffer for 90% of the show, this is for you Not good. The show is poor, but at least it was watchable. The FL is looking to infiltrate the new Dynasty to avenge her families massacre and the ML is a spy from the previous dynasty undercover. They go from enemies to lovers but are constantly on the back foot while the villains plan and scheme relentlessly to torture and murder innocents. What really bothers me with this type of show is the usual nonsense where villains like the adopted daughter who decide to redeem themselves are forgiven for all their crimes and face no accountability and have a happy ending and when the villains do get their comeuppance. It’s usually short and sharp and they die instantly where they’ve made the heroes suffer horrendous agony over a long period of time while they’ve been living in luxury and happiness . This kind of perverse pleasure in watching heroes suffer for 90% is quite disturbing and I don’t understand how Chinese audiences enjoy this kind of thing because there is no emotional satisfaction and the payoff is useless by the end. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Brilliantly written vertical drama about office romance in fashion industry I had never watched Song Chen drama and today I felt like watching his drama. I checked his MDL profile and the drama title caught my attention. Since Jwells mentioned raw video on iQIYI platform, I tried searching on my iQIYI app and voila, found the drama. I must say I was very impressed by the writing & directing elements of this drama.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was fairly new in the city and at the fashion industry but never easily intimidated. I liked her can-do spirit & problem solving capability.2. Writing - OMG this drama gave me US movie Devil Wears Prada vibe but the boss wasn't as aloof as Miranda Priestley. I loved that the drama covers professional & personal challenges in almost equal amount. This drama has depths.3. ML characterisation - ML strived for perfection but he was never cruel to his employees. I liked that he was flawed and slowly his walls were brought down by FL. I also liked that he was a self-made successful fashion editor-in-chief.4. Romance - Slowburn but satisfying. There were many sweet moments and good kisses. There is an almost spicy scene haha you know how it goes in vertical dramas.5. Acting - I was impressed by Song Chen & Kan Zi Yi's performance. KZY's FL was endearing and SC was cool & emptionally restraint at first but showed some vulnerability as the story progressed.6. Styling - Impeccable in particular ML's outfits. Damn he looked like a supermodel - I liked his height & build! FL and Daisy's clothes were beautiful & chic too.7. Supporting characters - I liked Li Xia the coffee shop owner. ML's brother and childhood friend were likeable too.What I disliked:1. Antagonist - I felt the antagonist's arc was too simplified. title: Deng Dai Ni De Jiang Lin
complete_title: Deng Dai Ni De Jiang Lin (2025)
synopsis: An accident grants Su Min the ability to travel between comic book worlds. She enters the comic "Drowning," co-created by Su Min and Su Yan Xiu, and approaches the disabled and gloomy Li Zhou as a transfer student, attempting to change his fate. Meanwhile, in reality, Su Yan Xiu is shaken by her unusual behavior. Traveling between the two worlds, Su Min gradually discovers that Li Zhou is Su Yan Xiu's dark mask, and that she falls in love with the real him beneath the mask. The two find mutual redemption between the comic book and reality, rewriting the ending—not drowning in darkness, but being reborn. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers The Shein version of W Two World The premise is that the female lead travels between a comic book and reality to save the male lead basically carbon copy of K-Drama W Two Worlds (2022).The plot is not smooth enough, actors' acting is average, the dubbing is very uncomfortable to listen. I watched this with 1,25x speed since it was not too engaging as K-Drama. The plot felt rushed as it progressed, with the romance and rebirth storylines feeling like they were fast-forwarded, as if they were rushing to finish because they didn't have enough time. It wasn't explained whether the FL stayed in that world forever, or whether the ML could leave or travel freely.Overall, it's somewhat watchable, but not top-tier. Those who like Zhang Shan and Wang Xuan might consider to watch this. Read More Was this review helpful to you?
